post.title: Gutter and Downspout Replacement Edmonds WA — Roof Drainage, Stormwater Connections, Fascia Repair and Permits
post.description: An Edmonds guide to replacing gutters and downspouts: when the City exempts the work from a building permit, where roof water is allowed to go, downspout dispersion and tightline rules, fascia repair, gutter guards and how to hire.

notes: Box-authored fallback. Home PC DESKTOP-B69F181 board-intake inbox had no 2026-11-18 packets (per parent); PC not touched. Topic: gutter and downspout replacement in Edmonds WA (first gutter daily; seasonal November rain). City of Edmonds: Work Exempt from a Building Permit handout (replacement or repair of existing gutters or downspouts exempt); Permit Assistance (all permits online via MyBuildingPermit; permit counter 121 5th Ave N, 425-771-0220); Informational Handouts; Engineering Codes and Design page; ECDC 18.30 Stormwater Management Code (adopts 2019 SWMMWW + Edmonds Stormwater Addendum, more stringent applies; illicit discharges prohibited per ECC 7.200; Category 1 at 2,000 sf new+replaced hard surface or 7,000 sf disturbance, Category 2 at 5,000 sf; new MS4 connections case by case with City approval, >=2,000 sf drained to MS4 triggers chapter); Stormwater Addendum Jan 2024 (till/hardpan soils; ~25% of land area slope >=15% or ESLHA, Meadowdale; multiple downspouts must all be managed); Appendix D checklist 14 (splash block <=700 sf roof, 50 ft vegetated flow path; dispersion trench 25 ft flow path, 1.5 ft deep, 4 in perforated pipe, >700 sf extra length + catch basin; 5 ft from property lines/easements; not in North Edmonds ESLHA or buffer without geotech); SD-631 Typical Downspout Dispersion (10x2 ft trench for <=700 sf roof); Stormwater Pumping Policy (pumps last resort; private force mains not direct to City system); Stormwater Utility page; Ecology SWMMWW manuals page; Washington 811. Edmonds already in _SLUG_PLACES/_PLACE_NAMES; generate_site.py unchanged; edmonds.html unchanged. Cross-links: Edmonds roof replacement 2026-09-21, Kenmore drainage 2026-10-27, Lake Stevens dry rot 2026-11-15. No fee or price figures. Producer role fields kept per intake contract.
